rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for things involving two or more people.

example.english: I find interpersonal relationships difficult sometimes.
example.traditional: 人同人之間嘅相處有時真係幾難搞。
example.jyutping: jan4 tung4 jan4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 soeng1 cyu2 jau5 si4 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 gaau2

rows.note: Use this compact form mainly in established combinations such as 人際關係 or 人際溝通, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: The company places great importance on employees' interpersonal relationships.
example.traditional: 公司好重視員工之間嘅人際關係。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 jyun4 gung1 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6
